decoders.intro: Decoders written in HSync's DSL run beside the built-in ones: load the module file the compiler writes (pnpm dsl:compile). A module named like a built-in decoder stands in for it while it is loaded, and the open capture decodes again with it. A capture file carries the modules its decoders use and brings them along when it is opened.
